FN-46MVIII-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 79
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 79 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain detention facilities,
domestic violence shelters, and public education institutions by an undetermined amount to
litigate civil actions filed due to a failure to designate multi-occupancy restrooms, changing
rooms and sleeping quarters for the exclusive use of either males or females, or take reasonable
steps to ensure the right to privacy.
